annotations.title: Search North Carolina (NC) Administrative Code rules by topic

description:
Search North Carolina Administrative Code (NCAC) rules — state agency regulations — by topic.

Use when you know the subject but not the rule: "how long to file a contested case",
"child care staff ratios", "septic permit requirements". Narrow with `title` ("15A") or
`chapter` ("15A NCAC 18A", or "18A" together with `title`). If you have a citation, use
get_rule instead.

Returns ranked rules with highlighted fragments; read one with get_rule. Results are
ordered the same way as search_statutes: by how many search words a rule contains, then
how much of its heading they make up, then rank. For the General Statutes the legislature
passes, use search_statutes.

query.description: Topic, keyword or phrase. Supports quoted "exact phrases", -excluded terms and `or`.
